core_obligations: Base case: for the first Tor module the proof uses a short exact sequence to embed it into a tensor product of a power of the ideal with the module, and then uses that the module is annihilated by a power of the ideal to make the comparison map vanish far enough along (proof lines 4521-4530)

Induction on the degree: assuming the statement in degree i the proof reduces the degree i+1 case to an instance with the residue ring as the module, using the vanishing input from the cited chapter (proof lines 4530-4545)

Combining the constants: the proof shows the relevant map for the residue ring vanishes after shifting by a further constant c', and combining the two vanishing statements with the short exact sequences gives the statement in degree i+1 with the sum of the constants (proof lines 4545-4552)
Conclusion: the stated existence of the constant c for every degree, which is the statement (proof line 4552)
proof_roadmap: i = 1 时用短正合列把 Tor_1 嵌进理想幂与 M 的张量积，由 M 被 I^m 杀死使比较映射在 n 足够大后为零。
归纳：设 i 阶成立，把 i+1 阶化到以 A/I^m 为模的情形（用被引章的消失结论），再把两个常数相加，得 i+1 阶成立。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives a vanishing range for maps between Tor modules of a module annihilated by a power of the ideal (author lemma at source lines 4510-4519, label lemma-maps-zero-fixed-torsion): for every degree and every bound on the annihilation power there is a constant after which the comparison maps between the two Tor modules vanish. The proof (source lines 4521-4552) is an induction on the degree: the base case embeds the first Tor module into a tensor product and uses the annihilation of the module (proof lines 4521-4530), and the induction step reduces the next degree to the case of the residue ring using the vanishing input from another chapter, then adds the two constants (proof lines 4530-4552). The induction and the constant bookkeeping are the content. H2.
